'''Nala Aldel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. She made her living as a [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] for [[Binary Star Realty]] aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Reputation Vendor for Binary Star Realty on the Imperial Fleet, Nala Aldel and her Republic counterpart [[Maia Vefri]] were added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in the [[2014]] Digital Expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Strongholds|''Galactic Strongholds'']].<ref name="TOR" />
